consent.title: Cookie settings
consent.noneText: We do not set cookies, do not use local storage and do not load analytics, marketing or other third-party services. There is therefore nothing you need to agree to. Should we add an optional service in the future, you will be asked for your consent here first, and optional services will stay off until you agree.
consent.bannerText: We would like to use optional services. They are only activated with your consent, which you can withdraw at any time under “Cookie settings” in the footer.
consent.necessaryText: Needed to deliver the website securely. These cannot be switched off.

meta.title: ConsultAxis | Business Consulting & Real Estate Consulting
meta.description: ConsultAxis UG supports companies, founders and property owners with practical business consulting and independent real estate consulting. Success Along Every Axis.

hero.title: Success Along Every Axis.
hero.lede: We analyse. We optimise. We help businesses and property owners make better-informed decisions.

divisions.title: Two areas of expertise. One company.
divisions.intro: ConsultAxis provides structured business and real estate consulting from Germany. We help companies improve their organisation, sales and operations, and support private and business clients with property analysis, documentation and economic assessments.

business.title: Business Consulting
business.text: Business optimisation, organisational development, sales improvement and operational efficiency.

realestate.title: Real Estate Consulting
realestate.text: Property analysis, market research, documentation review and economic property consulting.

axes.title: Every business has more than one axis.
paragraphs: Businesses face new challenges every day. Rising costs, inefficient workflows, untapped revenue opportunities and complex workforce structures can slow down business development.
ConsultAxis helps businesses review existing structures, improve operational processes and unlock their economic potential.
We combine commercial understanding with practical solutions. Rather than looking at individual areas in isolation, we consider how the key elements of a business work together.
axes.ambition: More structure. Greater efficiency. More business potential.

business.title: Business Consulting
business.lede: Five consulting areas for SMEs, retail and multi-site operations, service companies, hospitality, start-ups and international businesses. Each with a clear objective.

realestate.title: Real Estate Consulting
realestate.lede: Independent, property-related consulting for private owners, buyers, investors and businesses.
list: Real estate market and location analyses
Economic property assessments and market price orientation
Review and structuring of property documents
Identification of documentation gaps and inconsistencies
Preparation of property information and sales documentation
Preparing owners for a planned property sale
Support in compiling a professional property profile
realestate.note: Consulting only. ConsultAxis does not act as an estate agent or broker and does not arrange property transactions.

meta.title: Business Consulting | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Practical business consulting in five areas: people and organisation, sales and revenue, documents and processes, operations and costs, business development and strategy.

hero.title: Business consulting along five axes.
hero.lede: We look at people, sales, documents, operations and strategy as one system and turn the analysis into practical measures.

business.areasIntro: Each area can be commissioned on its own. Most projects touch several, because the axes of a business depend on one another.

scope.title: What our business consulting covers
paragraphs: ConsultAxis focuses on business, organisational and sales-related consulting. Technical IT consulting and software development are not part of our services.
We do not provide legal or tax advice, or other regulated services. Where these are required, they can be delivered by appropriately authorised specialist partners.

close.title: Which axis needs attention first?
close.text: Tell us where your business is under pressure: people, sales, processes, costs or direction. We will suggest a sensible first step.

people.title: People & Organisational Optimisation

meta.title: People & Organisational Optimisation | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Workforce structures, staffing requirements, scheduling, roles and responsibilities, organisational workflows and internal communication.

people.intro: When roles are unclear or staffing does not match demand, the whole organisation feels it. We review how your workforce is structured and deployed, and develop practical improvements together with you.
services: Optimisation of staff deployment and scheduling
Definition of roles, tasks and responsibilities
people.objective: Align people, tasks and responsibilities in an effective and practical way.
questions: Are roles, tasks and responsibilities clearly defined and known to everyone?
Does staff deployment match actual demand across shifts and locations?
Where do handovers and internal communication slow work down?

sales.title: Sales & Revenue Optimisation

meta.title: Sales & Revenue Optimisation | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Sales structures and processes, sales strategy, customer acquisition and retention, sales performance indicators and quotation structures.

sales.intro: Revenue depends on structures as much as on effort. We review how your sales work today, from acquisition to quotation to account development, and build a clearer, more efficient sales process.
services: Analysis of revenue and sales performance indicators
Optimisation of quotation and sales structures
sales.objective: Build transparent and efficient sales structures that support sustainable revenue development.
questions: How does an enquiry become a quotation, and a quotation an order?
Which customers and services contribute most to revenue?
Which indicators do you use to steer sales today?

documents.title: Document & Process Optimisation

meta.title: Document & Process Optimisation | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Structuring commercial and administrative documents, business templates, quotation and invoicing workflows, standardised forms and administrative processes.

documents.intro: Administrative work grows quietly: duplicate forms, inconsistent templates, manual steps. We structure your commercial and administrative documents and simplify the workflows behind them.
services: Structuring of commercial and administrative documents
Creation and revision of business templates
Optimisation of quotation and invoicing workflows
documents.objective: Reduce unnecessary administrative effort, improve transparency and establish clear workflows.
questions: How many versions of the same template are in use?
How long does it take from completed work to a sent invoice?
Which administrative steps are repeated by hand?

operations.title: Operational & Cost Optimisation

meta.title: Operational & Cost Optimisation | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Operating cost structures, cost-saving opportunities, operational workflows, resource utilisation and cost-effectiveness assessments.

operations.intro: Costs are rarely the result of a single decision. We review your operating cost structures and workflows, show where resources are used inefficiently and support you in planning and managing operations.
services: Support with operational planning and management
operations.objective: Help businesses use their financial and operational resources more consciously and efficiently.
questions: Which cost items have grown fastest, and why?
Where are staff, space or equipment under- or over-utilised?
Is the economic contribution of your key activities known?

strategy.title: Business Development & Strategic Consulting

meta.title: Business Development & Strategic Consulting | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Assessment of the business situation, strategic planning, business model and service offering, support for start-ups, growth strategies and change.

strategy.intro: Whether you are founding, growing or changing direction, decisions are easier with a clear picture of where the business stands. We assess the current situation and develop a strategic direction with you.
services: Assessment of the current business situation
Business model and service offering optimisation
Support during organisational and business change
strategy.objective: Establish a clear business direction and a sustainable foundation for future development.
questions: Does the current business model still fit the market and your goals?
Which services should be developed, and which reconsidered?
What does the organisation need for the next stage of growth?

close.title: Let’s look at {short} together.
close.text: Describe your current situation in a few sentences. We will come back to you with questions and a proposal for a first step.

meta.title: Real Estate Consulting – Property Analysis & Advisory Services | ConsultAxis
meta.description: Independent real estate consulting for private owners, buyers, investors and businesses: market analysis, property documentation review, sale preparation and economic analysis. Consulting only, no brokerage.

hero.title: Real Estate Consulting
hero.subtitle: Property Analysis & Advisory Services
hero.lede: Market analysis, documentation review and economic assessment for private owners, buyers, investors and businesses. Consulting only, no brokerage.

concept.title: A consulting division, not an agency.
paragraphs: Real Estate Consulting is an independent consulting service within ConsultAxis UG, alongside our Business Consulting. We focus on professional real estate analysis, property documentation, market research and economic consulting.
We do not act as an estate agent or broker and do not provide property brokerage or transaction services. Our services are intended for private individuals and business clients alike.

services.title: Real Estate Market Analysis
items: Analysis of local and regional property markets
Research into comparable properties and market developments
Location and neighbourhood analysis
Evaluation of general market conditions and potential opportunities
Economic assessment of property-related information

services.title: Property Documentation Review
items: Review and organisation of existing property documents
Checking documents for completeness and currency
Identification of missing, outdated or inconsistent information
Structuring property documentation into a clear and professional format
Preparation of checklists identifying documents that may still be required

services.title: Property Sale Preparation
services.intro: We support private property owners and business clients who are preparing to sell a property.
items: Organising and reviewing existing property documentation
Preparing structured property information
Identifying missing documents before a planned sale
Preparing and improving property descriptions and sales documentation
Providing market research and economic background information
Helping owners prepare for discussions with potential buyers or appointed estate agents
services.note: We do not market properties as brokers, arrange viewings on behalf of sellers, introduce buyers to sellers for the purpose of concluding a transaction or negotiate property purchase agreements.

services.title: Economic Property Analysis
items: Review of available property-related financial information
Analysis of operating costs and ongoing expenses
Evaluation of maintenance and renovation cost information provided by the client
Comparison of available market information
Preparation of economic summaries to support informed decisions

services.title: Buyer-Side Consulting
services.intro: We also support individuals and businesses considering the purchase of a property.
items: Comparing several properties based on available information
Researching the local property market
Reviewing the completeness of available documentation
Identifying inconsistencies or missing information
Preparing structured comparison reports
Providing an economic assessment based on the information supplied

audience.title: Who Real Estate Consulting is for
items: Private property owners
Individuals planning to sell a property
Prospective property buyers
Property investors seeking economic and market information
Companies and business owners
Other clients requiring independent property-related consulting
audience.note: This division is not restricted to commercial clients.

approach.title: Document review
approach.text: Reviewing and organising the available documentation.

approach.title: Market research
approach.text: Analysing relevant market and location information.

approach.title: Economic assessment
approach.text: Preparing a structured evaluation based on the available data.

approach.title: Recommendations
approach.text: Identifying open questions, missing documents and potential next steps.

limits.title: Scope and limits of our services
limits.intro: ConsultAxis provides property-related consulting, research, documentation review and economic analysis. ConsultAxis does not offer:
items: Real estate brokerage or property mediation
Buyer or seller introductions for the purpose of concluding property transactions
Proof of a specific opportunity to conclude a property purchase or sale
Legal advice or legally binding assessments of property documents
Tax advice
Architectural or structural engineering assessments
Certified property valuation reports or expert witness reports
Mortgage or financial product brokerage
paragraphs: Our review of property documents is limited to their availability, completeness, currency, consistency and apparent discrepancies.
Legal questions and binding legal assessments must be referred to qualified lawyers or notaries. Technical building assessments must be carried out by appropriately qualified specialists.

close.title: Planning to sell, buy or assess a property?
close.text: Tell us about the property and the decision ahead. We will review what is available and explain how we can support you, as consultants, not as agents.

meta.title: About Us | ConsultAxis
meta.description: ConsultAxis stands for practical consulting with a view of the bigger picture: people, processes, sales and organisation working together.

hero.title: Business consulting with a view of the bigger picture.
hero.lede: We believe sustainable business development is achieved when people, processes, sales and organisation work together effectively.

story.title: A practical approach to consulting
paragraphs: ConsultAxis stands for a practical approach to business consulting. We help businesses assess challenges in a structured way, review existing workflows and identify practical opportunities for improvement.
We see consulting as more than analysis. Our aim is to develop practical perspectives together with our clients and support sustainable improvements.
With Real Estate Consulting, we apply the same structured approach to property-related decisions of private and business clients.
story.message: We analyse. We optimise. We help businesses grow.

name.title: What our name stands for
name.text: ConsultAxis represents the different axes of business success: people, sales, organisation, processes, profitability and business development. We look at each axis, and at how they interact.
